entries.description: Fungal disease with ring-patterned dark spots on older leaves
entries.symptoms: dark spots with ring patterns on older leaves
entries.why: dark brown spots with ring-like patterns on older, lower leaves.
prevention: Rotate crops; avoid replanting tomato family in the same spot
non_chemical: Remove heavily affected lower leaves where guidance supports it
Water at the base in the morning; keep leaves dry
Clean tools between plants
Scout regularly and re-photograph new spots
Choose less susceptible varieties if available

entries.symptoms: water-soaked patches that turn brown and spread quickly

Water at the base in the morning; keep leaves dry
Clean tools between plants
